name: HDR Control
description: Turns HDR on or off for the primary display and makes a chosen color profile its HDR profile while a client streams, then puts back the previous settings when the application quits. Clients can also toggle HDR from their in-stream menu. Pick a profile made with the Windows HDR Calibration app, or any other installed HDR profile.
author: Sunshine

options.label: HDR
options.description: HDR mode of the primary display during the stream. Leave this as it is when the Virtual Display plugin sets the HDR mode, or when Sunshine's display device configuration turns HDR on.

options.label: HDR profile
options.description: Color profile the primary display uses in HDR mode during the stream. Its current HDR profile is listed first. Override it for an application or a client to give each its own.

options.label: Wait for HDR mode (seconds)
options.description: How long to wait for the display to switch to HDR mode before leaving its profile as it is.

options.label: Put back the previous settings
options.description: When the application quits, turn HDR back on or off as it was, make the display's previous HDR profile its HDR profile again, and unlink any profile the plugin linked. Turn this off to keep the stream's settings.
